item.subject: maths
item.stem: Rohan looks at the diagram. He has drawn base $GH$ of length $8\,\mathrm{cm}$. He must build triangle $GHI$ with $GI = 7\,\mathrm{cm}$ and $HI = 6\,\mathrm{cm}$.

options.text: At a meeting point of an arc from $G$ of radius $7\,\mathrm{cm}$ and an arc from $H$ of radius $6\,\mathrm{cm}$.
Anywhere on the dashed arc drawn from $G$, because that arc is labelled first.
On the midpoint of segment $GH$, because $GH$ is the drawn base.
At endpoint $H$, because $H$ already sits on the base.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.
